questions.question: How long does the merchant setup take?
questions.answer:
Usually setup and KYC verification takes no more than 24 hours after providing corporate documents.
We make the onboarding fast and transparent — sign the agreement, configure your settlement rules, and start accepting global payments the next day.

questions.question: How does an international customer pay?
questions.answer: Customers pay in their home currency through localized payment methods including domestic bank transfers, instant QR codes, debit/credit cards, or digital wallets. No extra app downloads or tedious registrations required.

questions.question: What currencies can I receive settlements in?
questions.answer: You can receive payouts in KRW, AED, VND, THB, or USDT — tailored directly to your corporate account preferences. Your customers can pay across many local currencies worldwide.

questions.question: Are there any hidden fees or foreign transaction surcharges?
questions.answer: No. All conversion margins are transparently included in the checkout rate. The client sees the exact final price before paying, and your business receives 100% of the invoiced amount with zero surprise deductions.

questions.question: How much does the setup cost?
questions.answer: Setup is completely free — zero setup fees, zero monthly subscription fees, and no minimum commitment required. You only pay competitive volume-based transaction rates.

questions.question: Is the payment infrastructure safe and compliant?
questions.answer:
Yes. All transactions are routed through regulated financial institutions with end-to-end encryption, PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance, and automated AML/anti-fraud screening.

High Pay Fin operates strictly within licensed financial frameworks and adheres to global compliance regulations.

questions.question: What documents are required for onboarding?
questions.answer: You will need standard corporate registration documents, beneficial owner IDs, proof of business address, and bank account details for settlement. Our team will guide you through the digital onboarding portal.

questions.question: Can I monitor real-time transactions and download financial reports?
questions.answer: Yes. Your business dashboard provides real-time transaction streaming, status filters, multi-currency balances, and one-click financial export to CSV or Excel for your accounting and tax teams.

questions.question: What business industries is High Pay Fin suited for?
questions.answer: Our solution is universally built for any business with cross-border clientele: e-commerce, software & SaaS, hospitality & travel, real estate, B2B wholesale, luxury services, and digital agencies.

questions.question: How are foreign exchange (FX) rates determined?
questions.answer: We source real-time institutional exchange rates from global liquidity providers. The exchange rate is locked for the duration of the payment session, protecting you and your customer from market volatility.
